buyer_profile.cash_constraint: 20% down; HELOC about $100k available at ~8%; hard money/line available around ~15% for larger needs
buyer_profile.flip_learning_question: Is $30k net profit possible after rehab, selling costs, financing/carry?
buyer_profile.rental_goal: Minimum about $300/month profit after mortgage, taxes, insurance, fees, vacancy/maintenance/management reserves; $500/month is ideal but expectations are flexible.
buyer_profile.rehab_partner: Talented builder partner; rehab time matters
buyer_profile.timeline: Comfortable with 3 to 5 month rehab/resale or stabilization timeline.
buyer_profile.capital: No starting cash for deals; approximately $100k HELOC is intended for both purchase and rehab. Goal is to build a war chest from early wins.
buyer_profile.neighborhood_safety: Avoid crazy high crime areas; neighborhood safety should be a hard screen.
